purpose: Make a repository issue the first durable session graph, then bound working-set growth by separating admission, pre-PR validation, workbench, maintenance, and operator-attention lanes.

admission.evidence: closing-keyword link (Fixes/Closes/Resolves #N) to an admitted issue, where admission is either a default-branch issue_numbers entry or the latest exact command from an authorized actor; legacy PRs may use an explicit pull_request_numbers entry

session_admission.command_rule: The latest exact command in an issue comment from an authorized actor controls admission. Issue body text, assignment, labels, and unauthorized comments never grant admission.
session_admission.preflight_requirement: Validate the exact branch head SHA from a trusted default-branch workflow before opening a PR.
session_admission.pull_request_linkage: A PR must use a closing-keyword link to exactly one admitted session issue.

branch_preflight: security scans that do not require PR context

maintenance.standing: author identity only; labels refine cohorts and never grant maintenance standing

control_plane.exemption: only when every changed file is a control-plane path; mixed changes require admission

notes: Issue 378 is seeded because PRIORITY_QUEUE.md already marks Q-TEMPORAL-DISSOLUTION-01 as the global GATING architectural repair.
Admission determines working-set standing only. It does not ratify governance, approve code, or authorize merge.
When admitted ready-for-review work exceeds capacity, the coordinator does not choose winners; it reports capacity contention for operator resolution.

The gate reads this file from the default branch (pull_request_target). A PR cannot admit itself by editing this file, and touching a control-plane file alongside feature work does not exempt the feature work.
Two ready PRs linking the same admitted objective are both held (DUPLICATE_ACTIVE_IMPLEMENTATION); the coordinator does not choose a winner.
